dedupe_keys.name: goblin lite irish land balance scenario model

description: GOBLIN Lite is a Python model for Irish agriculture, forestry and land-use scenarios. The JOSS paper describes herd, soil and forest accounting and outputs for greenhouse gases, nitrogen losses and other impact categories. The own repository identifies GPL-3.0 code and documents supporting GOBLIN packages, so the published model is free under its own terms. Inputs are Irish land areas, livestock assumptions, forest and soil parameters and scenario choices. Outputs are static land balances and environmental impact comparisons. Its published geographic scope is Ireland; alternative countries would require new input data and accounting checks. Infrastructure planners could compare food production and land requirements under energy or water-transition pathways. That is an inferred coupling use, not a built-in grid or water network model. A caveat is that national inventory assumptions and related package versions can change results. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed. Dependencies were not installed and no scenario was run.
inputs: Irish land-use, livestock and soil scenario parameters
name: GOBLIN Lite Irish land balance scenario model
notes: G5 G5-0896. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
outputs: Land balance, emissions and environmental impact estimates
